f.n: Burøytjern
f.pu: The purpose of conservation is to preserve an important wetland area with vegetation, birdlife, and other wildlife that is naturally associated with the area.
f.re: 1. All vegetation in water and on land is protected from all forms of damage and destruction. It is forbidden to remove plants or parts from the reserve. New plant species must not be introduced. 2. Wildlife, including their dens, nests and eggs, is protected against any damage, destruction and unnecessary disturbance. Chasing wildlife is not allowed. 3. No measures may be taken that may change the natural condition…
f.rn: Regulations for Burøytjern Nature Reserve, Kragerø Municipality, Telemark; Management Plan

f.n: Hörnum-Odde / Sylt
f.pu: For the preservation and protection of the Hörnum-Odde, which is characterized by a beach and dune landscape with typical flora and fauna, and which is one of the most threatened habitats in Schleswig-Holstein.
f.re: In the nature reserve, nature must be preserved in its entirety. It is prohibited to: 1. introduce, damage, uproot, or dig up plants, 2. release animals, stalk, disturb, capture, injure, or kill wild animals, or remove or damage pupae, larvae, eggs, or nests and other breeding, living, or refuge sites of these animals, 3. extract soil components, carry out blasting, excavation, or embankment work, introduce soil com…
f.rn: Landesverordnung über das Naturschutzgebiet Hörnum-Odde/Sylt Vom 2. Dezember 1972 (State ordinance establishing the reserve)
f.ma: Schleswig-Holstein Ministerium für Energiewende, Klimaschutz, Umwelt und Natur

f.n: Humber Estuary- Spurn Point Seagrass Area
f.pu: To protect important seagrass beds, a protected sub-feature of the Humber Estuary European Marine Site, and to ensure that the North Eastern IFCA is meeting its statutory duties in accordance with the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2010.
f.re: The following is prohibited: 1. Digging or using any pots, traps, nets (whether or not fixed or anchored to the seabed), trawls, dredges or similar devices within the specified area. 2. Taking any sea fisheries resources from the specified area.
f.rn: North Eastern Inshore Fisheries and Conservation Authority XXIX Humber Estuary Fishing Byelaw

f.n: Medway Estuary and Marshes - River Medway Restricted Area
f.pu: To protect the habitats that support a diverse range of water birds throughout the year, and the species listed in Annex I of the Council Directive 79/409/EEC. There are large areas of mudflat, which have high densities of invertebrates providing a good food source for wading birds.
f.re: 1. A person must not fish for, or take by any means, sea fisheries resources within the restricted area. 2. A person fishing in the District must not carry any sea fisheries resources into or through the restricted area.
f.rn: River Medway Nursery Area (Prohibition of Fishing) Byelaw
